title: My parent may need to live with me, and I don't know what that requires
intro: Considering having a parent move in is a big, loving decision — and it's completely normal not to know where to start.
reassurance: Thinking it through before you commit is exactly the right approach.

roadmap.whatsHappeningNow: A successful move depends on your parent's needs, your home, and the support around you.
whatMayComeNext: Care needs often increase over time — plan for change, not just today.
Caregiver burnout is common without a real support plan.
Home modifications may be needed for safety and access.
changesToWatchFor: The level of daily help your parent needs
Your own capacity, stress, and available support
Whether the home can be made safe and accessible
howToPrepare: List the daily help your parent needs now and may need soon.
Assess home safety and possible modifications.
Line up backup support and respite before the move, not after.
